content.short: Pentas promotes Web3 adoption and provides an NFT marketplace, smart contract development, an NFT launchpad, and blockchain consultancy.
content.description: Pentas acts as a gateway and a low-entry tool built to accelerate mass adoption of Web3 across multiple ecosystems. It combines an NFT marketplace, smart contract development, NFT launchpad, and blockchain consultancy, all designed to lower barriers for new users and developers. User journeys remain central to Pentas, guiding onboarding experiences and making it easier for newcomers to explore the world of blockchain across supported chains such as BNB Chain, Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon.
content.meta: Pentas is a gateway and a low-entry tool focused on mass adoption. Discover Pentas and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
